title: 'No better person': Ashwin backs MS Dhoni to succeed Fleming as CSK coach
summary: Ravichandran Ashwin discussed Chennai Super Kings' new chapter after Stephen Fleming's departure. He believes MS Dhoni would be the ideal choice to lead the team.
